name: Token Miser
description: Retains oversized tool output and uses a helper model to deliver bounded summaries with exact retrieval. Helper calls can incur provider charges.

helperModel.label: Helper model
helperModel.help: Optional provider/model. Requires the plugin LLM model-override policy. Helper calls can incur provider charges.

thresholdBytes.label: Reduction threshold (bytes)
thresholdBytes.help: Minimum original UTF-8 text-content JSON size considered for helper reduction.

maxSummaryBytes.label: Summary limit (bytes)
maxSummaryBytes.help: Maximum delivered summary and retrieval-reference size.

retentionHours.label: Original retention (hours)
retentionHours.help: Originals expire after this interval. Disabling the plugin prevents further retrieval while disabled.

maxStoredBytes.label: Original storage limit (bytes)
maxStoredBytes.help: New retention fails open at capacity; accepted originals are not evicted early.
